scope.meaning: Static consumption, registered route and built composite content only; source-import, visual fidelity and user acceptance remain separate.

policy.confirmed_missing: Actual source/registered consumer plus absent route or absent usable composite. Weapon metadata alone never qualifies.
policy.consumed_and_covered: Source consumer route built with basic-magazine actor clips and FX content in one bounded scene.
policy.unconsumed_fields: Native data field is not read by the registered basic action consumer; do not synthesize shot count.
policy.source_only_unknown: Resource evidence outside selected construction, explicitly passed --active-wip, or construction error not safely attributable to ammunition.

limitations: Lua token scanning is a conservative discovery mechanism. Source calls and registered consumers establish contracts; mere token/field matches remain unknown.

All available styles/actions/graphs are statically listed; only one default mythical/basic source contract per pack and one alternate rifle family per applicable pack are constructed. No costume/direction/skin sweep.
Composite actor clips and FX presence do not establish rendered animation continuity or visual parity.
Summonables remain independently owned entities; their names and weapon metadata cannot override owner stamina cost. Turret autonomous action is not a five-round owner magazine.
Unconsumed weapon fields are scoped to currently registered actions and can become consumers after future implementation changes.
